create_annealing_lr_scheduler: create an AnnealingLR scheduler with linear cosine or constant decay style for a PyTorch optimizer
get_learning_rate: get the current annealed learning rate based on warmup iterations and decay style
step_lr_scheduler: step the AnnealingLR scheduler to update the optimizer learning rate for the next iteration
save_lr_state_dict: save the AnnealingLR scheduler state dict with start_lr warmup_iter decay_style and end_iter
load_lr_state_dict: load an AnnealingLR scheduler state dict from checkpoint with optional override of class values
